**A contract review is owed before the queue.** The PR body and the changeset both open their declaration line with `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`. ### ① Derived judgments

**(a) The renderer — right.** At the head the `filterFields` memo in `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` is `candidateFields.filter(canReadField).filter(f: !isHidden(f.value) || held.has(f.value))` (the arrow spelled as a colon here, because the sanitizer eats tag-shaped fragments), then the unchanged tier sort. At BASE, for a view WITHOUT the key, the predicate `(!whitelist || whitelist.has) && (!isHidden || !!whitelist || held.has)` with `whitelist === undefined` reduces to exactly `!isHidden || held.has`, so a view with no key sees the same list, in the same order: the no-key row of `ListView.filterFieldList-11810` ("offers no hidden field, and orders columns …") is not in the diff. For a view WITH the key, the whitelist branch and the `!!whitelist` hidden-field exemption are gone, which is the spec's own prescription at `4bc3becd5f` ("offers every field the user may read: field read security decides, and a field the object definition marks `hidden: true` is not offered"). A held condition still keeps its field (`held.has`), and the read check `canReadField(perms, schema.objectName, f.value)` still runs first, unchanged. The deps array drops `schema.filterableFields` and nothing else. Nothing else in the derivation moved: the `ListView.tsx` hunks are the memo body, its docblock, and one comment in the sort section; `candidateFields`, `tierOf`, `effectiveFields` ordering and the sort comparator are untouched. `git grep filterableFields` on the head tree finds no remaining code read anywhere: outside tests and docs only comment lines in `ListView.tsx`, `plugin-list/src/index.tsx`, `plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` and `objectql.zod.ts`, plus the two by-reference declarations judged in (c).

**(b) Published faces — narrowing only; `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` is the true reading.** The four `package.json` `exports` maps are unchanged on the head; what they publish moves as follows.
- `@object-ui/types` `.` (dist/index.d.ts; the barrel at `packages/types/src/index.ts` exports `ListViewSchema`, `ObjectViewSchema`, `NamedListView`): `NamedListView.filterableFields` goes from `?: string[]` to `?: never`, a narrowing refused by name (pinned by `_FilterableFieldsTombstoned` and the `@ts-expect-error` row `_refusedFilterableFields`). `ObjectViewSchema.filterableFields` goes from `?: string[]` to `ListViewSchema['filterableFields']`; `ListViewSchema` is `z.input` of the mirror built from `specFieldsExcept(stripImportedDefaults(SpecListViewSchema).shape, …)`, so at the pin that slot is the spec's `z.array(z.string()).optional()`, i.e. `string[] | undefined`, the same accept set as before (the tree sets no `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`). Neither narrower nor wider today; narrows at the pin bump. Pinned by `_FilterableFieldsIsTheSpecSlot`.
- `@object-ui/types/zod`: the `ObjectViewSchema` mirror's runtime accept set is unchanged (comments only around the by-reference line).
- `@object-ui/plugin-view` `.`: the `object-view` registration's `inputs` loses `{ name: 'filterableFields', type: 'array' }`. That list IS a published authoring surface: per the console parity test's header, `inputs` is serialized into `sdui.manifest.json` and `sdui-intrinsics.d.ts` and is `sdui-parser`'s `validateTree` whitelist, so an author who still writes the key on an `object-view` node now gets `unknown-prop`. A narrowing, and the right one under ruling 「C」; `objectViewHostSurface.test.tsx` pins it with a positive control (`navigation`, `searchableFields` still published). The spec models no `object-view`, so the reverse parity direction is owed nothing. `OBJECT_VIEW_DECLARED_FORWARDED_KEYS` (31 reads become 30: 27 host-composition plus 3 declared) is a module-level constant not re-exported from the package entry; its shrink is pinned, not published.
- `@object-ui/plugin-view` and `@object-ui/app-shell` behaviour: the three-rung relay (`currentNamedViewConfig ?? activeView ?? node`) and the app-shell object page's forward (`viewDef.filterableFields ?? listSchema.filterableFields`) are deleted, so a stored view still carrying the key no longer reaches a renderer prop. Behaviour narrows; no type face widens. `objectViewHostSurface`'s SENTINELS row asserts the node's `filterableFields` does not reach the host renderer while `searchableFields` still does.
- `@object-ui/plugin-list`: `ListViewProps.schema` is the spec-derived `ListViewSchema`, unchanged this PR; behaviour narrows (the whitelist is no longer honoured).
Nothing widens: no new key, no new input, no `any`, no index signature, no loosened zod arm, no new export.
